title: Role at AWS Connect
content: Anqi was a Software Development Engineer at Amazon Web Services on the AWS Connect team in Seattle, Washington, from September 2022 to June 2026, working on a platform serving 20 million or more daily chat interactions at 99.99 percent availability.

title: Agentic AI incident diagnosis system
content: She built a production-grade ReAct-based agentic AI system on AWS Bedrock for automated incident diagnosis, orchestrating MCP-enabled tools to access internal ticketing, logging, and codebase systems with hybrid RAG for enterprise knowledge retrieval. This reduced root cause analysis time by 90 percent.

title: Self-correction and evaluation pipeline
content: She designed a self-correction loop with LLM-as-judge critic models that automatically verified intermediate LLM outputs to reduce hallucination, eliminating 80 percent of manual review effort. She also curated internal incident datasets and built offline and online evaluation pipelines that improved agent diagnosis accuracy by 36 percent through iterative prompt refinement and few-shot learning, with evidence-backed citations and human-in-the-loop verification.

title: Chatbot initialization feature
content: She led the design and delivery of an event-driven chatbot initialization feature supporting 800K+ daily chats for AWS Connect, delivering $1M+ ARR in business impact by unlocking enterprise customer adoption through personalized first-interaction routing that eliminated redundant greeting prompts.

title: Distributed systems and messaging architecture
content: Her engineering work includes architecting SQS-based asynchronous message routing with session caching for 20K+ real-time message sessions, reducing DynamoDB load by 95 percent and decoupling bot processing from message ingestion under burst traffic, achieving 99.99 percent service availability across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

title: Cloud-native testing platform on EKS
content: She architected a cloud-native testing platform on AWS EKS, migrating 100 percent of internal testing services to an automated cloud-native execution framework built with Docker containers and Helm charts, reducing test deployment time from 6 weeks to 10 days while achieving 99.99 percent infrastructure availability.

title: Technical product management
content: Before AWS, Anqi worked as a Technical Product Manager at Amifor Management in Atlanta from May 2021 to August 2022, leading end-to-end technical product delivery.

title: Smart lock application
content: At Amifor Management, she worked on a Smart Lock platform with more than 1,000 daily active users, translating business requirements into system prototypes and improving operational efficiency by 60 percent through workflow automation.

title: Information Systems degree
content: Anqi is completing a Master of Science in Information Systems at Trine University, with dates listed as January 2024 through December 2025.

title: Business Analytics degree
content: She also earned a Master of Science in Business Analytics from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, with dates listed as August 2019 through December 2020.

title: LLM engineering skill set
content: Her LLM engineering skills include LLM inference, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, tool calling, agent frameworks like LangGraph, vector databases, human-in-the-loop workflows, evaluation with RAGAS, DeepEval, and LLM-as-judge, and observability with LangFuse.

title: Overall profile
content: Her overall profile combines 4+ years of Amazon-scale distributed systems engineering with hands-on production experience shipping LLM agent systems, including RAG, MCP tool orchestration, and evaluation pipelines. She is a strong fit for backend, platform, infrastructure, and applied AI or agent engineering roles.
